gaps.summary: Current branch defines the atomic transaction/CAS store contract and deterministic in-memory reference adapter, but does not yet compose a production PostgreSQL multi-replica implementation and migration on this stacked chain.
NODE-28 routing and NODE-29 request resolution are adapted, but production executor wrappers still need explicit claim -> execute -> complete/fail/suspend wiring around every task category.

NODE-33 records budget ceilings and observed cost, but concurrent paid-provider admission must still use the authoritative durable cost-reservation and idempotency boundary before provider acceptance.
Hosted Actions on the current stacked Agent chain cannot allocate runners because of the account billing/spending-limit condition. Zero-step failures are not code-test failures.
